title: Workspace mount fans out one messages request per channel
description:
**Observed 2026-09-16 on live dev.chattic.us while investigating `5e4c9a`.**

Mount of `/chat/` issues roughly **60 parallel** `GET /api/orgs/{org}/channels/{id}/messages` requests — one per channel, all at once, before the person has opened any of them. Counted in the browser network log on the Anthus org.

This is not currently broken. `cea55d` already replaced `Promise.all` with a settle-all fan-out, so one slow channel no longer takes down the whole load. The problem is shape, not correctness: the request count is linear in channels, so an organization with 500 channels issues 500 requests on every mount, against per-connection limits and whatever throttling sits in front of the API.

**Worth deciding before a customer has a large org, not after.** Candidate directions, not a decision:
- Fetch messages only for the visible channel; fetch others on selection.
- One batched endpoint returning the latest message per channel for the sidebar preview, with full history on open.
- Keep the fan-out but bound concurrency.

The sidebar appears to need only the latest message and timestamp per channel, which is what makes the batched-summary option attractive — but confirm that against `loadWorkspace` before designing anything.

**Not urgent.** Filed so it is a decision we make deliberately rather than a support ticket later.
